title: Prince William and Kate begin a three-day visit to India
summary: The Earthshot Prize awards are held in Mumbai tonight, before the couple meet Narendra Modi.
body:
The Prince and Princess of Wales arrived in Mumbai on Monday 16 November for a three-day visit to India.

On their first day they played a game of street cricket at Ballard Estate and travelled on the city's metro. It is their first joint visit to India since 2016.

The Earthshot Prize

The sixth Earthshot Prize awards, William's environmental prize, take place in Mumbai tonight. On Wednesday the couple will travel to New Delhi to meet Prime Minister Narendra Modi.

Sources: ABC News, NBC News, The National.
